`create_model` computes `flat_snapshots` and uses it to flatten `n.model.parameters`, but never converts `sns` itself from the MultiIndex returned by `as_index`. Consequently, all variable and constraint builders—including both transmission-loss modes—still receive MultiIndex snapshots even when `"flat"` is selected explicitly or through `"auto"` under v1 semantics; the component-data context does not change that argument.
